name: Format Converter
description: Convert between JSON, YAML, TOML and CSV with automatic input detection and preserved key order
help: Choose “Auto detect” to paste any format; the detected format appears below the input.
Multi-document YAML (---) becomes an array; TOML date-times are kept as strings.
TOML has no null and needs a table at the top level; the exact path is reported when that happens.
For CSV pick the delimiter, whether the first row is a header and whether to infer numbers / booleans; nested objects become a.b columns when converting to CSV.
placeholder: Paste JSON, YAML, TOML or CSV…
waiting: The converted result appears here once you enter some input
